children: Fully managed cloud-based solution provides independent and rural operators with a seamless path to voice network modernization
PLANO, Texas, Sept. 9, 2026 /PRNewswire/ --
(Nasdaq: RBBN), a global leader in real-time communications technology, IP routing, and optical networking solutions, today announced that

, a global leader in trusted voice communications, will incorporate Ribbon technologies in the TNS Hosted Cloud Connect solution. The carrier-grade voice solution helps Communications Service Providers (CSPs) modernize their voice networks without the cost and complexity of owning and operating voice infrastructure.

Hosted Cloud Connect is purpose-built for CSPs seeking a practical modernization path that avoids the disruption, cost and risk of a traditional network replacement. The solution has already attracted interest from CSPs looking to simplify the management of complex voice environments by reducing the operational burden associated with maintaining legacy switching infrastructure while helping maintain service continuity, reduce operational complexity and support future communications services.

"CSPs need a practical path to modernize legacy voice environments without disrupting critical services," said Joe Dechant, Vice President, TNS. "TNS's and Ribbon's proven voice technologies can help CSPs reduce operational complexity, maintain service continuity and prepare for future communications needs."

Independent and rural operators face growing pressure from multiple directions. Voice services require extremely high levels of reliability, continuity and operational stability, making it difficult to simply "rip and replace" existing networks.  Residential and business customers expect more advanced communications services. These providers must also manage increasing regulatory requirements and a shrinking pool of specialized technical talent. To remain competitive, CSPs must invest in new services while controlling costs and preserving the reliability their customers expect.
Ribbon and TNS address these challenges by leveraging Ribbon's

(AS), Session Border Controller (SBC), and Policy and Routing Server (PSX) and TNS Hosted Cloud Connect to help streamline the transition from on-premises infrastructure to cloud-based voice services while maintaining the voice quality, resiliency, and security required for carrier operations.

"For many CSPs, the challenge isn't deciding whether to modernize legacy voice switches, it's finding a cost-effective way to make the transition," said Elizabeth Page, Sr. Sales Director, Ribbon. "TNS Hosted Cloud Connect provides a practical path from legacy infrastructure to a modern cloud-based platform without sacrificing the resiliency, security, and service quality operators require. Together, Ribbon and TNS are helping CSPs simplify operations, lower costs, and extend the value of their voice business."

About Ribbon

Ribbon Communications (Nasdaq: RBBN) is a global provider of voice communications software, IP routing, and optical networking to mobile and wireline service providers, enterprises, critical infrastructure and defense sectors. We support our customers' Path to Autonomous Networks by leveraging the latest AIOps automation platforms and Agentic AI technologies, helping them deliver better customer experiences, reduce operational costs, and achieve sustainable growth. To learn more about Ribbon, visit rbbn.com.
About TNS Communications Market

TNS is a global leader in trusted communications, helping operators, enterprises and consumers exchange information with confidence. Backed by deep industry expertise and global reach, TNS is enhancing trust in communications while helping customers modernize and grow in an increasingly connected world. The company's cloud-based platforms combine advanced call analytics, digital identity and numbering intelligence to keep networks, devices and applications connected and protected.
